prompt: Design a spectacular $8 million Spanish-style villa with a central courtyard, elegant arches, terracotta roof and swimming pool.

body.summary: Casa del Patio is a spectacular two-level Spanish Hacienda arranged around a U-shaped central courtyard open to a generous rectangular swimming pool. Sand stucco, divided-light glazing, terracotta-toned hip roofs, and true semicircular arcades create an elegant, sunlit Mediterranean retreat; the $8 million ambition is expressed through its expansive proportions and outdoor living spaces, not an exact cost estimate.
